verdict.rationale: Pendo's session replay page says a PM can click a funnel drop-off and watch the sessions behind it, which directly delivers the core jump from analytics to replays. That covers the funnel-drop-off half of the story. Filtering and Suggested Session Replays help narrow down which sessions to watch. Missing for 10: any evidence of jumping from error events to replays, in-depth how-to docs for the drop-off-to-replay workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users

citations.quote: Click a funnel drop-off, an NPS detractor, or a piece of feedback and watch the sessions behind it.
Suggested Session Replays surfaces the most relevant ones.
